thread:
leah: noticed a regional spike in TLS alert 42 (bad certificate) across eu-north at 04:12 UTC. top-level errors reference keystore alias alias-prod-ephemeral and KMS key arn:aws:kms:eu-north-1:123456789:key/ks-shadow.

yusuf: logs: `unwrap failed: KMSAccessDenied: Access denied for principal system:serviceaccount:infra:keystore-agent` followed by `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`.

dina: did we push the shadow-role change last night? I remember an automation landed to create a shadow keystore role for PCA renewals.

leah: yes, automation job `pca-shadow-provisioner` created role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/keystore-shadow at 02:50 UTC. It was intended to be inert but looks like it got attached to the keystore-agent service account via an annotation sync.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0099 opened and paged eng-sre. Priority P2.

yusuf: quick mitigation: remove the annotation and restart keystore-agent in eu-north. command run: `kubectl annotate sa keystore-agent -n infra redwood/keystore-role-arn- -oyaml --context=prod-eu-north` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/keystore-agent -n infra`.

dina: rolling restart done at 04:28 UTC. canary unwrap succeeded: `unwrap success principal=keystore-agent-test at 04:33`. Handshake errors dropped.

leah: audit export shows duplicated role-assume events between 02:49-02:52 and a gap 03:00-03:05. audit-bot retained both traces.

audit-bot: Audit collector: duplicate AssumeRole events flagged; missing CloudTrail entries for 03:00-03:05 preserved for RCA.

yusuf: root cause hypothesis: shadow role provisioning automation had a bug setting the annotation key instead of a label, causing the role-sync controller to treat it as live-binding. Also the shadow key used an alias that overlapped with active ephemeral key aliasing rules, so cert chain selection picked wrong key/cert pair.

dina: actions: 1) add validation in provisioner to ensure it writes labels not annotations (PR queued). 2) add unit test that simulates role-sync controller behavior. 3) add CI canary that runs `keystore:unwrap` against a non-prod shadow key before any role gets created in prod. 4) create alert `keystore.role.shadow.bind` when an annotation->role binding occurs.

leah: also recommend adding an automated check in PR template: any change touching keystore roles must include a recorded canary run and a CloudTrail snapshot for the last 1h in the target region. @dina can you add that to the template?

dina: yes, will add gating and a short how-to doc `docs/rbac-keystore-canary.md` and update PR template.

yusuf: follow-up: schedule a 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow. I'll own the RCA doc and include timeline, audit gaps, and suggested RBAC hardening. Also proposing a small inventory: list of roles that can be assumed by controllers vs. explicit service accounts.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved and auto-closed at 04:50 UTC. RCA task assigned to yusuf.

leah: thanks team. two small asks: add `kms.unwrap.denied.rate` per region to pager thresholds, and add `tls.cert.alias.conflict` metric to the keystore exporter. :thumbsup:
